The test results show a cholestatic pattern with markedly elevated alkaline phosphatase (460 U/L) but relatively mild elevation in transaminases and normal bilirubin, which does not support a diagnosis of pneumonia. To confirm the cause of the biliary obstruction, have you experienced any right upper quadrant pain, fever, or loss of appetite?
